user_message: I can still read email on my phone, but the HR app on my Mac says the account is disabled.
expected_response: Your account looks locked. Wait 15 minutes, try signing in once with the correct password, and let us know the exact sign-in error if it still fails.
resolution_steps: Confirm the exact lockout or sign-in error message.
Wait 15 minutes and try one sign-in with the correct password.
Verify the account is not locked in the standard support directory tool.
Escalate for manual unlock if the account remains blocked.

user_message: I forgot my password over the weekend and the reset completed, but I still cannot sign in to the office portal.
expected_response: Please reset your password through the approved reset page, then sign out and back in to affected apps after a short wait for sync.
resolution_steps: Confirm whether the password is expired or recently changed.
Reset the password in the approved self-service portal.
Sign out of affected apps and wait a few minutes for credential sync.
Sign back in and escalate if the new password is still rejected.

user_message: Outlook on my laptop shows need password in the status bar and my mailbox never opens.
expected_response: Close and reopen Outlook, confirm the password is current, and test sign-in through webmail to isolate whether this is an app or account issue.
resolution_steps: Confirm the exact Outlook sign-in or credential prompt error.
Test the same account in webmail to verify the mailbox is accessible.
Restart Outlook and remove any stale credential prompt if applicable.
Escalate if Outlook still cannot authenticate while webmail works.

user_message: My Android VPN app says credentials rejected every time I try to connect.
expected_response: Confirm your password and MFA approval, then retry the VPN connection after restarting the client.
resolution_steps: Confirm the exact VPN authentication error message.
Verify the username, password, and MFA approval are correct.
Restart the VPN client and retry the connection.
Escalate to the network team if authentication still fails.

user_message: My laptop can see the office printer, but it changes to offline as soon as I try to print.
expected_response: Check that the correct printer is selected, clear any stuck jobs, and confirm the device shows online before printing again.
resolution_steps: Confirm the printer name and whether others can print to it.
Clear stuck jobs from the print queue.
Verify the printer is online and selected correctly.
Escalate to desktop support if the printer remains offline.

user_message: The shared drive reconnects after reboot, but a specific department folder still shows permission denied.
expected_response: Confirm the folder path and try reconnecting the drive, since this may be a permission or mapping issue.
resolution_steps: Confirm the exact shared folder path that returns access denied.
Check whether other shared locations are accessible.
Reconnect the mapped drive or retry the UNC path directly.
Escalate for access review if permission is still denied.

user_message: Teams keeps switching away from my USB headset microphone and using nothing instead.
expected_response: Check the selected microphone in Teams settings, confirm the device works in another app, and restart Teams before joining the meeting again.
resolution_steps: Confirm whether the microphone fails only in Teams.
Check the selected recording device in Teams and system sound settings.
Test the microphone in another app or audio test tool.
Restart Teams and escalate if audio input is still missing.

user_message: My browser started showing script errors on the expense site after I enabled a coupon extension by mistake.
expected_response: Try the site in a private window or with extensions disabled to confirm whether the issue is caused by a browser add-on.
resolution_steps: Confirm which browser and site are affected.
Test the site in a private window.
Disable extensions temporarily and retry the site.
Clear site data and escalate if the page still fails.

user_message: I can sign in on my new device, but Teams and Outlook are missing from the company setup list.
expected_response: Follow the company setup prompts with the work account, confirm required apps are installed, and note the exact step where enrollment stops if it fails.
resolution_steps: Confirm whether the device is new or recently reimaged.
Sign in with the correct work account and complete enrollment prompts.
Verify required company apps appear after setup.
Escalate to endpoint management if enrollment does not complete.

user_message: My browser, Outlook, and file explorer all freeze for a few seconds at a time on this laptop.
expected_response: Restart the device, close heavy applications, and check whether the slowdown affects the whole workstation or just one app.
resolution_steps: Confirm when the slowness started and whether all apps are affected.
Restart the workstation and close heavy applications or browser tabs.
Check for low disk space or background sync activity.
Escalate if the workstation remains slow after basic checks.

user_message: Teams meetings work, but my camera stays black even though the laptop camera light comes on.
expected_response: Check the selected camera in Teams, confirm camera permissions are enabled, and close any other app that might be using the device.
resolution_steps: Confirm whether the camera works in another camera test app.
Check the selected camera in Teams settings.
Verify camera permissions in the operating system and close other camera apps.
Restart Teams and escalate if the image remains black.

user_message: My laptop is usable after login, but the fan stays loud and Task Manager shows one background process using very high CPU.
expected_response: Restart the laptop, check whether the same process returns, and close non-essential apps so support can confirm whether this is a persistent CPU issue.
resolution_steps: Confirm which process is showing high CPU usage.
Restart the laptop and see whether the same process returns.
Close non-essential apps and confirm whether CPU usage drops.
Escalate if high CPU usage continues after restart.
